card.name: Sub in CYP enzyme substrate headings
card.fires_on: The first piece "Sub" of the word "Substrates" in drug-interaction headings. It comes right after an enzyme or transporter name such as CYP3A4 or P-glycoprotein, usually in section 7.2 on effects on other drugs.

modes.label: Transporter substrates
modes.description: "Sub" of "Substrates" after a transporter name such as P-glycoprotein.

card.writes: It promotes tokens spelling "Sub", which helps the model write out "Substrates".
card.plain: It marks the start of the word "Substrates" in headings for drugs affected by an enzyme such as CYP3A4.
